review.method: Independent source comparison and native caller inspection; primary direction check confirmed by reviewer.

source_storage: Source text remains on the original disc; bind by inventory ID and SHA-256.

notes.86: The brightness of the configured color triggers a five-minute screen-saver delay; this is not a five-minute screen-saver duration.
notes.87: The source does not name whose class has increased. The status label preserves that omission pending the class screen.
notes.88: The item needing no repair is omitted in the source. Passive English preserves that omission.
notes.91: The returning subject is omitted in the source; retain the generic status rather than name a person or Marionette.
notes.100: Suffix after a live price; leading space separates the number from yen. The caller uses numeric mode -1, which adds no currency symbol.
notes.109: Confirm stopping, which causes disqualification; do not ask ambiguously whether to continue the battle.
notes.114: Suffix following the elapsed-time readout; preserve its leading space. Neutral elapsed avoids singular/plural disagreement. Runtime hour/minute unit snippets remain Japanese outside this slice.
notes.115: Suffix following the clock-time readout in the alarm branch; the caller confirms this is a reached alarm time. Runtime hour/minute unit snippets remain Japanese outside this slice.
notes.118: Insertion prefix followed by a live port/socket label and row 119. Leading insertion instruction moves the Japanese suffix meaning into this prefix.
notes.119: Both pointer aliases and all four insertion callers verified: the instruction is carried by translated prefixes 118, 121, 142 and 153. Runtime destination labels 163-170 remain Japanese outside this slice.
notes.121: Insertion prefix for the memory card containing existing user data, not a new save destination.
notes.128: Select two through sixteen participating Marionettes in the left window.
notes.131: The object being checked is omitted in the source; retain the generic progress status.
notes.142: Insertion prefix for a user-data save destination, followed by the live port/socket label and row 119.
notes.144: Purchased-Marionette save confirmation prefix, followed by one-line port/socket label 155-162 and row 145. Caller order verified; Port D labels 161/162 remain Japanese outside this slice.
notes.145: Save-confirmation suffix; possessive attaches to the preceding runtime port/socket label. Keep both newlines.
notes.149: The object being copied is omitted in the source. Retain the generic operation status pending the active file/Marionette context.
notes.150: The object being moved is omitted in the source. Retain the generic operation status pending the active file/Marionette context.
notes.153: Insertion prefix for saving the purchased Marionette, followed by a live port/socket label and row 119.
notes.154: The stock category is omitted in the source; retain the generic status.
